item.title: Check Point Security Management / Multi-Domain Server SmartConsole Authentication Bypass via Forged Application Certificate Bind (CVE-2026-16232)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.1) — network · CVE-2026-16232. Status: Patched. Affects: Check Point Security Management Server and Multi-Domain Security Management Server (MDS) — the legacy FWM/CPMI SIC service on TCP 18190 and the CPM SOAP web services on TCP 19009. Tags: check-point, smartconsole, security-management-server, multi-domain-server, cpmi, sic, fwm, authentication-bypass, CWE-287, improper-authentication, privilege-escalation, sso-token-forgery, soap, dle, cisa-kev, bod-26-04, python, firewall-management.
